cards.hint: Think about the year gap between votes.
cards.quote: An election for president of the United States happens every four years on the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November.
cards.stem: How often does the election for president happen?

cards.hint: Recall the exact November date mentioned.
cards.quote: The next presidential election is scheduled to be on November 7, 2028.
cards.stem: When is the next presidential election scheduled to occur?

cards.hint: Think of the body named for choosing the president.
cards.quote: Electors cast their votes for president in the Electoral College.
cards.stem: Where do electors cast votes for the top office?
